decks.notes: This deck focuses on quickly and aggressively dealing damage to the opponent through low cost creatures and direct burn spells. By efficiently utilizing resources and leveraging the synergy between cards, the goal is to apply constant pressure and force the opponent to react defensively, ultimately overwhelming them before they can stabilize. With a mix of fast creatures and direct damage, this deck aims to end the game quickly and decisively, making it a formidable force in the premodern 1 vs 1 format.

The deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana with cards like Mox Diamond and Weathered Wayfarer to play powerful land creatures like Terravore and Nimble Mongoose. Armageddon is used to disrupt the opponent's mana base while Sylvan Library helps maintain card advantage. Swords to Plowshares offers removal while Call of the Herd and Exalted Angel provide additional threats. The deck also includes cards like Naturalize and Rishadan Port for utility and disruption. Overall, the deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent with efficient creatures and disruptive spells.

The Mono Blue Control deck focuses on maintaining control of the game through counterspells, removal, and card advantage. It aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while slowly building up its own resources. Cards like Counterspell, Force Spike, and Stifle help prevent the opponent from resolving key spells, while Standstill and Fact or Fiction provide card draw and selection. Parallax Tide can be used for board control, while Mishra's Factory and Faerie Conclave serve as win conditions. Phyrexian Dreadnought and Phyrexian Furnace offer additional utility and threats. The deck is geared towards outlasting the opponent and gaining incremental advantages.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game through disruption and removal spells, while also utilizing the powerful Oath of Druids combo to pull out game-winning creatures like Terravore. The deck aims to slow down the opponent with cards like Sphere of Resistance and Winter's Grasp, while also maintaining card advantage with Sylvan Library. The land base is designed to provide consistent mana sources while also having utility lands like Wasteland and Rishadan Port to disrupt the opponent's game plan.

The deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana with mana dorks like Llanowar Elves and Priest of Titania to power out high-cost creatures like Deranged Hermit and Masticore. Wirewood Symbiote provides protection and card advantage, while cards like Survival of the Fittest and Tangle Wire help control the board. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of powerful Elves and other creatures, utilizing Gaea's Cradle and other mana sources to maintain a constant stream of threats. The deck aims to win through aggressive creature-based strategies while leveraging its mana advantage.

The deck focuses on controlling the opponent's board and hand while building up its own resources. It utilizes a mix of counterspells, removal spells, card draw, and disruptive creatures like Meddling Mage to dominate the game. The key strategy is to disrupt the opponent's game plan while gradually growing threats like Quirion Dryad and Psychatog to eventually win the game. Additionally, the deck can quickly recover from resource management with cards like Gush and Mox Diamond.

The main focus of this deck is to efficiently and quickly assemble key combo pieces through various tutors and card draw spells. It is designed to win through a powerful combo sequence using cards like Cabal Ritual, Lion's Eye Diamond, and Ill-Gotten Gains to generate strong advantage and end the game in a swift and decisive manner. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while setting up its own win condition, making it a potent and adaptable strategy in Premodern 1 vs 1 matchups.

The main idea of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells in order to deal damage quickly and efficiently. By utilizing low-cost creatures and powerful burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Fireblast, the deck aims to reduce the opponent's life total as quickly as possible. The inclusion of cards like Sulfuric Vortex and Price of Progress further demonstrates the deck's focus on dealing direct damage to the opponent rather than controlling the board. With a focus on speed and direct damage, this deck aims to win the game before the opponent can establish a strong defense.

The deck focuses on assembling a quick and powerful combo involving Hermit Druid, Phyrexian Dreadnought, and Reanimate effects to quickly fill the graveyard and bring back a massive creature. It includes cards like Stifle and Sylvan Safekeeper to protect the combo pieces, along with disruption like Duress and Cabal Therapy to disrupt opponent's strategies. The goal is to quickly set up the combo and overwhelm the opponent before they have a chance to react, utilizing the synergy between graveyard manipulation and reanimation effects to create a lethal threat.

The main focus of this deck is to utilize the speed and aggression of Goblins to overwhelm the opponent quickly. By playing cards like Goblin Lackey and Goblin Matron to bring out powerful creatures like Goblin Piledriver and Siege-Gang Commander, the deck aims to put constant pressure on the opponent. Supporting cards like Goblin Warchief and Gempalm Incinerator help to maintain board control and deal with threats efficiently. Cards like Rishadan Port and Wasteland are included to disrupt the opponent's mana base and slow down their game plan.

The deck focuses on quickly overwhelming opponents with a swarm of aggressive Goblin creatures. By using cards like Goblin Lackey and Goblin Matron to cheat out powerful Goblin creatures like Goblin Piledriver and Siege-Gang Commander, the deck can quickly amass a threatening board presence. Cards like Gempalm Incinerator provide removal options while cards like Goblin Warchief and Goblin King boost the power of the Goblin tribe. The deck also includes some utility cards like Naturalize for additional flexibility. Overall, the deck aims to win through fast and efficient creature aggression.

The main focus of this deck is to control the board and disrupt your opponent's game plan while utilizing the Oath of Druids card to bring out powerful creatures like Terravore. It aims to slow down the opponent's progression with cards like Sphere of Resistance and Swords to Plowshares, while also being able to ramp up with Mox Diamond and Sylvan Library. The deck also includes land destruction cards like Wasteland and Rishadan Port to further disrupt the opponent's mana base. Ultimately, the goal is to outpace and outmaneuver the opponent to secure a victory.

The primary focus of this deck is to control the game through various means while utilizing the powerful combo of Oath of Druids and Opalescence to quickly overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures. The deck also includes a strong suite of removal spells, card draw, and utility lands to help maintain control of the battlefield and outvalue the opponent. The goal is to set up the Oath of Druids combo as quickly as possible while disrupting the opponent's game plan and protecting your own key cards.

The focus of this deck is to utilize the combo of Replenish and Opalescence to bring back enchantments from the graveyard as creatures, turning them into a win condition. Cards like Parallax Wave and Parallax Tide provide additional control and utility, while cards like Attunement and Intuition help set up the combo. Tsabo's Web helps disrupt opponent's strategies and Seal of Cleansing provides removal. The deck aims to control the board and set up a game-winning combo with its enchantments.

This deck focuses on utilizing the synergy between creatures that can be sacrificed and cards that can be played from the graveyard to gain control of the game. Through cards like Recurring Nightmare and Survival of the Fittest, the player can manipulate their graveyard and hand to effectively control the board and outvalue their opponent. With a mix of removal, card draw, and powerful threats, this deck aims to grind out the game and overwhelm the opponent with powerful creature synergies.

The deck focuses on efficiently casting low-cost creatures with the Madness ability, such as Basking Rootwalla and Wild Mongrel, to quickly apply pressure on the opponent. It also includes cards like Frantic Search and Careful Study to fill the graveyard and enable Madness. Survival of the Fittest helps to tutor for key creatures like Arrogant Wurm, while disruptive spells like Counterspell and Daze protect the game plan. The mana base includes City of Brass, Forest, Island, Wasteland, and Yavimaya Coast to support the deck's color requirements and disrupt the opponent's mana base.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize various discard spells and creature tutors to set up a quick combo win with Hermit Druid, Nomads en-Kor, and Cephalid Illusionist. By using these creatures in combination, the player can quickly mill their entire library and win the game with either Sutured Ghoul or Terravore. The deck also incorporates reanimation spells like Reanimate and Exhume to bring back key pieces if they end up in the graveyard. Additionally, Living Wish provides additional flexibility in finding specific cards from the sideboard to fit the situation.

This deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana with elves and utilizing powerful creatures such as Deranged Hermit and Multani's Acolyte to overwhelm the opponent. The deck also includes cards for creature recursion and removal like Caller of the Claw and Nantuko Vigilante. With Gaea's Cradle and Survival of the Fittest providing additional support, the deck aims to swarm the board with creatures, disrupt the opponent with Tangle Wire, and finish with a game-changing Biorhythm spell to seal the victory.

The main concept of this Enchantress combo deck is to use cards like Argothian Enchantress, Enchantress's Presence, and Sterling Grove to draw and play as many enchantments as possible. By utilizing cards like Replenish and Opalescence, the deck is able to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a large number of enchantments on the board. The deck also includes cards like Elephant Grass and Solitary Confinement to protect itself while setting up the combo. With Serra's Sanctum providing mana acceleration, this deck aims to create a powerful enchantment synergy to win the game.

The main focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive swarm of goblins. By utilizing cards that boost goblins' abilities and allow for quick deployment, the deck aims to quickly establish board presence and deal damage efficiently. Additionally, there are a few cards included for removal and disruption to control the flow of the game. The mana base is constructed to support the aggressive playstyle while also providing some utility lands for extra control over the game.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with an aggressive army of Goblins, quickly setting up the board with cards like Goblin Lackey and Goblin Warchief. The deck focuses on quickly building up a formidable force with cards like Goblin Piledriver and Siege-Gang Commander, while also utilizing cards like Goblin Ringleader to draw more Goblins into your hand. With a mix of creature support and removal spells like Naturalize and Gempalm Incinerator, this deck aims to consistently apply pressure and outpace the opponent in the early game.

Utilizing a combination of card denial, creature removal, card advantage, and the powerful Oath of Druids card, this deck aims to control the game and set up for a win condition through the Oath ability. By disrupting the opponent's strategies with counterspells, removal, and land destruction, the deck can buy time to find and activate Oath, summoning powerful creatures into play and overwhelming the opponent. With a mix of control elements and key combo pieces, this deck seeks to outmaneuver and outlast opponents in a slow and deliberate manner.

The main objective of this deck is to control the game through disruption and land destruction with cards like Sphere of Resistance, Wasteland, and Rishadan Port. The deck aims to slow down the opponent's game plan while also using Oath of Druids to cheat creatures like Terravore into play. The deck also includes cards like Sylvan Library for card advantage and removal like Pyroclasm and Naturalize to deal with threats. Overall, the deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy while establishing a strong board presence.

The main focus of this deck is to control the board by disrupting the opponent's game plan while utilizing the powerful Oath of Druids to cheat out powerful creatures like Terravore. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Sphere of Resistance and land destruction effects like Wasteland to slow down the opponent's progression. Additionally, cards like Sylvan Library offer card advantage and selection to help set up the combo pieces. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent through a combination of control elements and powerful creatures.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly assemble the combo of [[Opalescence]] and [[Parallax Tide]] or [[Parallax Wave]] with the help of [[Attunement]] and [[Frantic Search]]. By utilizing cards like [[Replenish]] and [[Intuition]], the deck aims to lock down the opponent's board while setting up a win condition with its enchantments. Cards like [[Swords to Plowshares]] and [[Mana Leak]] provide disruption and protection, allowing the combo to go off smoothly. Overall, the deck aims to control the game and win through a powerful enchantment-based combo.

The main focus of this Aggro - Sligh (RDW) deck is to quickly deal damage to the opponent by constantly playing low-cost and efficient creatures and burn spells. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy, using cards like Grim Lavamancer, Mogg Fanatic, and Ball Lightning to apply pressure. The deck also includes direct damage spells like Lightning Bolt and Fireblast to finish off opponents. Additionally, cards like Sulfuric Vortex provide ongoing damage to maintain board control and close out games quickly.

The main focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells to quickly reduce their life total to zero. The strategy involves playing efficient, low-cost creatures like Jackal Pup and Mogg Fanatic alongside powerful burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Incinerate. The deck aims to maintain pressure on the opponent while using cards like Sulfuric Vortex and Cursed Scroll to deal consistent damage and finish off the opponent with a direct damage spell like Fireblast. The mana base is optimized to consistently provide the necessary red mana for casting spells.

The main focus of this deck is to use cards like Stifle, Vision Charm, and Boomerang to disrupt the opponent's game plan while setting up the combo of playing Phyrexian Dreadnought for a cheap cost. The deck also includes a lot of card draw and counterspells to help protect the combo pieces and control the game. Misdirection is included as a one-of for additional protection. The deck aims to quickly assemble the combo and win the game before the opponent can mount a defense.

This deck focuses on utilizing the combo of Phyrexian Dreadnought and Stifle to quickly bring out a powerful threat while disrupting the opponent's strategy. Meddling Mage helps to protect the combo by naming key cards in the opponent's deck, and Squee, Goblin Nabob provides constant card advantage. The deck also includes various control elements such as Swords to Plowshares and Duress to handle threats and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Vision Charm and Intuition help to find key pieces of the combo, while the mana base provides consistent colors for casting spells.

The deck aims to quickly assemble the combo of Phyrexian Dreadnought and Stifle to create a powerful threat while disrupting the opponent's game plan with counterspells and bounce spells. The deck focuses on drawing cards and manipulating the top of the library to find the necessary pieces to execute the combo efficiently. The goal is to control the pace of the game and win through a fast and decisive attack with the powerful Dreadnought while keeping the opponent off balance with disruptive spells.

The key concept of this deck revolves around utilizing the Tinker card to search for powerful artifacts, sacrificing the Phyrexian Devourer to generate large amounts of graveyards, and then using Fling to deal massive damage to the opponent. The deck aims to quickly assemble the combo pieces while utilizing cards like Oath of Druids and Impulse to find the necessary cards. Additional control elements like Defense Grid and Tangle Wire help to protect the combo and slow down the opponent's game plan. The mana base of the deck is designed to support the combo pieces with a mix of non-basic lands and mana acceleration.

The deck focuses on utilizing the Madness mechanic to quickly deploy threats and disrupt the opponent's game plan. By using Wild Mongrel and other Madness cards, the deck aims to discard cards for value and cheat out powerful creatures like Arrogant Wurm and Wonder. The deck also includes a toolbox of creatures like Waterfront Bouncer and Squee, Goblin Nabob to provide additional utility. Counterspells and bounce effects help protect our threats and disrupt the opponent's strategy, while Survival of the Fittest acts as a powerful tutor engine to find key pieces.
